case: `attempt_ceiling` stops being required on `WorkOrder`, so a work order carries no ceiling until it has already failed.
why: F6C-10: the committed state the finding measured. R-X10 puts the maximum attempt count ON THE WORK ORDER with a named owner; it lived on FailureRecord alone and optional, so the bound existed only after the thing it bounds had happened. Removing it from `required` is the one-line move that restores that, and the registry half is what notices.
expect_failure_contains: REGISTRY AND SCHEMA DISAGREE ABOUT WHICH PAYLOAD FIELDS ARE REQUIRED
